name: Tilted card line chart
what: A dark card with a logo and a short name at its top right, a faint grid and a line chart, seen almost edge-on in 3D at first while its dashed axes are drawn and the line starts to grow; a cut brings the card facing the camera, the line keeps growing and turns to your accent colour while a price counter counts up and a light runs round the card's edge; then the card slides away to the left with a motion blur and a closing line settles in its place.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f49 the card is seen almost edge-on in strong 3D and turns very slowly; f12-f44 the vertical dashed axis is drawn downward, from f44 the horizontal one; f14 the line starts to grow; f50 a hard cut to the card facing the camera (it drifts a little to the end); the line grows steadily, over the spike f86-f94 (its tail fades) to f124 and turns from grey to the accent colour f80-f112; f55 the counter appears at $0 and counts up one step a frame f79-f119; a light runs round the card edge the whole time; f132-f152 the card slides away to the left (an S-curve, a horizontal blur) uncovering the closing line, which settles f132-f160; 24 frames a second
